name: Cristina Bucșa
intro: Cristina Bucșa plays for Spain. She was born in Moldova and moved to Spain at age three. She won an Olympic bronze medal in doubles in 2024.
story: Cristina's dad Ion was an Olympic biathlete. That is skiing plus target shooting! He carried Moldova's flag at two Winter Olympics. Now he is her coach. This year she won her first big singles title in Mexico.

funFacts.text: Her birthday is January 1. She is a New Year's baby!
She speaks four languages: Spanish, Romanian, English and French. She is learning Korean too.
She has a blue belt in karate.
She once played Wimbledon in too-big shoes stuffed with socks. She still won!
She has no Instagram or TikTok. She says she is too busy training.
In spring at home she can ski in the morning and swim in the sea after lunch.
She won an Olympic bronze medal in doubles at Paris 2024.

watchFor: Watch her rush to the net for quick volleys, like a doubles champ.
